_note: Platform UI margins in px on the reference canvas (ref width × ref height); the player scales them to the reel's width. Platforms publish margins for ads only and change their UI; the organic numbers are conservative estimates from third-party measurements. Check a real upload on a phone. `crops`: centred width:height windows the platform also shows: `feed` is how the video plays in the feed (Instagram 4:5), `cover` how its cover appears in link previews (1:1). --guides draws them; reels/vertical margins must cover the feed crop, QA checks the cover's text against the cover crop and writes feed and cover review sheets. Sources and dates: docs/reference/formats.md.
